<span id="一、概述"></span>
# Background information

In the privatization environment of DataTester, it provides you with several user rights control dimensions such as group, project, enterprise department organization, and product function. You need to plan the rights control dimensions of the business according to actual business needs.


|Dimensional segmentation |Detailed description |Planning example |
|---|---|---|
|Group and group administrators |* The group is the division of product use management capabilities, and the management and use capabilities of a set of products are divided into multiple sets through the "group" and distributed to different sub\-businesses for use.<br><br>* Under each group, there are independent "projects, users, departments, roles", that is, the permissions under each group can be independently managed and authorized. |The enterprise has multiple sub\-businesses, which are completely independent of each other (including personnel changes, organizational structure, permission management, data analytics, etc.).<br><br><img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," /> |
|Projects and project administrators |* Project management is a resource group management method provided by BytePlus, which allows you to manage data resources used by different businesses or projects in groups, isolating and authorizing them based on the project. |If the company has multiple projects, the business data of each project is managed separately, making it easy to view, analyze, and manage the actual operation of each project<br><br><img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," /> |
|Corporate sector |The enterprise department is mainly an organizational form of users, organizing users in a departmental structure, which can be used in scenarios such as authorization ||
|DataTester Features |Perform permission control for DataTester product segmentation functions for roles, such as viewing and editing permission refinement of experimental management function modules. ||


In addition, as an administrator, you need to understand the permission management policy of DataTester. DataTester's rights system is a role\-based permission management design (RBAC), which indirectly grants users permissions by means of user\-associated roles and role\-associated permissions.

<img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," />

Therefore, you need to create corresponding users and roles according to the business plan, and complete authorization operations for user roles.

<img src="data:image/svg+xml;base64," />

<span id="842bf6a3"></span>
# Operation process

<span id="三、用户管理"></span>
## Add and manage users

4.8.0 and later versions, you need to manage users in the admin center.

<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/38cd928497484f38b250a20aba51c7af~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

Activity details See [Create and Manage Users](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/DataTester/Create-and-Manage-Users), After you have created a user, you can set permissions for the user through roles.


* If the user role you need to authorize does not exist, you need to add the corresponding role first, see **Add and manage roles** below.

* If the user role you need to authorize has been created, you can authorize directly through the role, see **Role Authorization** below.


<span id="四、角色管理"></span>
## Add and manage roles

<span id="默认角色"></span>
### Default role


* 4.8.0 and subsequent versions, there is only one default role: Administrator. New users in this version can plan roles and corresponding permissions according to business needs, manually create additional roles in the management center, and subsequently grant permissions to roles. To create a role, see the Creating a Role section below.

   <div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="tip" data-tips-is-title="true" data-wrapper-indent="1">tip   </div>
   

   <div data-tips="true" data-tips-type="tip" data-wrapper-indent="1">The default administrator role of the system will not be displayed in the management center of the privatization console. It is a unique role of DataTester, but actually the "app administrator" of an application. Users who bind applications to projects default to administrators and have full permissions to bind applications.   </div>
   

* 4.7.0 and previous versions, the system provides four roles by default, and administrators can modify the scope of permissions of the system default role or add new roles according to business needs.

   
   |Role name |Role Description |
   |---|---|
   |Administrator |Product members and roles can be managed |
   |Safety officer |All experiments can be closed, generally used to suspend the experiment urgently when the experiment affects the user's normal use. |
   |Experimenter |You can create experiments, view experiment details, experiment reports, and more. It is generally recommended that students who are involved in opening experiments and modifying experimental information apply. |
   |Analyst |You have read\-only permissions for experiments under the product, you can edit test users, and you cannot create experiments. It is generally used for experimental analysis, experimental function acceptance testing, and other scenarios. |
   


<span id="添加角色"></span>
### Create role

4.8.0 and later, you need role management in the admin center.

<span>![图片](https://p9-arcosite.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-goo7wpa0wc/1fc8971447fd4da8922377fa2a5e90db~tplv-goo7wpa0wc-image.image) </span>

Activity details See [Create and Manage Roles](https://docs.byteplus.com/docs/DataTester/Create-and-Manage-Roles), Once the role is created, you can begin fine\-grained permission control of the role.
